title: spawn_tick proc (demo.odin) is dead code; lower_spawns inlines the identical formula
detail: The two formulas AGREE (both floor(at_ms*hz/1000), no +1) so there is NO determinism inconsistency. But spawn_tick is a newly-added orphaned helper and lower_spawns is the one function that should call it, duplicating the logic instead.
recommended_fix: In lower_spawns call tick := spawn_tick(&s, hz) (de-duplicate), or delete the unused spawn_tick proc if lower_spawns is its only intended consumer.
